title: Add fiat-denominated send amounts to the iMessage app
body:
The macadamia iMessage app currently lets users send Bitcoin/ecash directly from Messages, which is a very useful feature.

However, the iMessage send flow only appears to support entering an amount in sats. In the main macadamia iOS app, I can enter a send amount denominated in my chosen fiat currency, for example GBP, and the app converts this to sats.

It would be useful if the iMessage app had the same fiat-denominated send option.

## Current behaviour

In the iMessage app:

* Open Messages
* Select macadamia from the iMessage apps
* Choose a recipient/mint
* Enter an amount

The amount is entered in sats only.

## Expected behaviour

The iMessage app should allow the user to enter an amount in their selected fiat currency, matching the main app behaviour.

For example:

* User enters 10 GBP
* App shows the converted amount in sats
* User generates/sends the token as normal

Ideally, the iMessage app would use the same fiat currency preference and exchange-rate logic as the main app.

## Why this matters

For casual “pocket money” payments, fiat-denominated entry is much more intuitive. If I want to send someone £5 or £10 worth of Bitcoin in Messages, I currently have to manually convert that to sats first, even though the main app already supports this flow.
